name: About Modal UI
description: Version/credits dialog with app info and clickable design.md link.

dom.root: .about-overlay (position: fixed, inset: 0, background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6), display: flex, align-items: center, justify-content: center, z-index: 10000)
children: .about-modal (background: var(--surface), border: 1px dashed var(--border), border-radius: 8px, padding: 32px, min-width: 320px, text-align: center)
.about-modal h2 (text: 'Cockpit IDE', font: Space Mono, font-size: 20px)
.about-modal .link (text: 'design.md', color: var(--accent), text-decoration: underline, cursor: pointer)

interactions.name: open_link
interactions.result: OS browser opens with design.md content

interactions.name: close
interactions.action: Fire onClose callback → Remove overlay from DOM

states.open: Overlay visible, version and runtime info displayed, link rendered
